title: Lagune configs
description: A Lagune project's configs: the categories it uses, the index of its own specializations, and what its checkers leave out.

$schema.description: The address of the schema this file follows.

categories.description: The categories whose built-in specializations join the project's catalog. While absent, the project uses owasp alone.

catalog.description: The index of the project's own specializations, each one winning over a built-in of the same name.

name.description: The specialization's name, also the name of its file in .lagune/catalog/.

tags.description: What the specialization covers, matched against the project's code.

checkers.description: What the checkers leave out when they scan the project. A checker's own settings replace the shared ones key by key, and a path a scan names is scanned whatever they say.

gitignore.description: Whether the scan leaves out what Git ignores: the project's .gitignore files, its local exclude file, and the user's global excludes file. Files Git tracks are scanned either way.

ignore.description: Paths or glob patterns from the project root a scan leaves out, each with everything under it, whether Git tracks it or not. * matches within a folder name, ** across folders, ? one character, and [abc] one of a set. A pattern cannot start with !.

checker.description: This checker's own settings, each replacing the shared one of the same name.
